theater: 羅馬城與台伯河下游戰線

battle.name: 羅馬之劫 (410年)
battle.theater: 羅馬城與台伯河下游戰線
battle.brief: 410年8月24日，亞拉里克率西哥特軍攻破薩拉里安門，縱掠羅馬三日，再沿台伯河下游南撤。卡面的亞述長矛屬同族對照：短柄長刃、配鐵鏨，與羅馬重標槍 pilum 及哥特長矛 framea 出自同一支刺擊兵器傳統，說明城牆內外雙方爭的是同一類兵刃。

kit.name: 亞述長矛
kit.history: 短柄、長刃，配著鐵鏨。亞述人把它和弓、鐵器綁在一起，兩河流域的城一個接一個陷落。

countries: 410年的羅馬之劫，交戰的兩邊是西羅馬帝國與西哥特人，但真正把形勢推成戰爭的，是三方力量的交錯。羅馬方面：皇帝霍諾留斯本人坐鎮拉文納，遠離都城，能實際調兵的是軍務總督弗拉維烏斯·斯悌里古與兩位禁軍總監奧利奧多魯斯、赫拉克里烏斯；城內有元老院、市區民兵（Cornuti 與 Scutarii 兩種持盾兵）與帝國禁軍 scholae palatinae 的精銳騎兵；邊防則由受薪傭兵、同盟者（foederati）與匈人雇兵組成，410年參與守城的一支匈人部隊只有三百人。西哥特方面：亞拉里克一世率領的是一支被安置在摩西亞與色雷斯的同盟者集團，以戰鬥人員計約四萬上下，另有家眷、奴隸與隨軍匠人隨行；編制以營（campus）與部落分隊為單位，步兵以矛兵與弓箭手為主，騎兵比例高於羅馬城防軍。第三方是東哥特人拉達蓋蘇斯：他於406年率大隊越過阿爾卑斯進入北義大利，與布艮德人、阿蘭人聯手，一度打到米蘭；戰敗身亡後，其部眾有上萬人被強行編入羅馬軍隊，而與此同時，數萬德意志同盟者的家屬在羅馬城內遭殺害，隨後流亡投奔亞拉里克，把一支安置在邊境的人集團變成帶著全族怨恨的重裝軍。第三方還有匈人：匈王烏爾丁在406年參與擊敗拉達蓋蘇斯，410年又以三百騎兵參與守城。羅馬城本身則是第四個要素——它的糧食、港口與海運，才是全場勝負真正的秤砣。
countriesEn: The sack of Rome in 410 was fought between the Western Roman Empire and the Visigoths, but the shape of the war was actually set by three parties in motion. On the Roman side, the emperor Honorius held court at Ravenna, far from the capital; the men who could really move troops were the magister militum Flavius Stilicho and the two praetorian prefects, Olympiodorus and Heraclius. Inside the city sat the senate, the urban militia in its two shield-bearing forms, the Cornuti and the Scutarii, and the elite mounted guard of the scholae palatinae; the frontiers were manned by paid soldiers, by foederati and by hired Hunnic cavalry, and the Hunnic contingent that helped defend Rome in 410 numbered three hundred men. On the Visigothic side, Alaric I led a federate settlement placed in Moesia and Thrace, numbering around forty thousand men fit for service, with families, slaves and craftsmen in train; its units were the campus and the tribal war-band, its infantry spear and bow, and its proportion of cavalry was higher than that of the Roman city garrison. The third party was the Ostrogoths under Radagaisus, who in 406 led a mass across the Alps into northern Italy alongside the Burgundians and the Alans and reached Milan; after his defeat and death more than ten thousand of his men were pressed into Roman service, while at the same time tens of thousands of German foederati families were killed inside Roman cities and fled to join Alaric, turning a frontier settlement into a war-band that carried a whole people's grievances with it. The Huns were a third party as well: Hunnic king Uldin helped beat Radagaisus in 406, and three hundred Hunnic horsemen took part in the defence of Rome in 410. Rome itself was the fourth element, and its grain, harbour and sea transport were the true scale on which the whole campaign was weighed.
people: 核心人物繞著亞拉里克與兩位皇帝轉。亞拉里克一世是西哥特人的王，約395至400年間被推舉，年輕時於392年被狄奧多西與斯悌里古擊敗，394年隨東帝國大軍參加弗里吉杜斯戰役，397年在福洛埃被包圍，402年波倫提亞、403年維羅納連敗。405至406年他以同盟者身份隨羅軍入義大利攻打拉達蓋蘇斯，這是他第一次踏上意大利的土地；408年斯悌里古倒台後，他立刻叛走並掉頭對付羅馬。409年三次圍城中的第二次由他主導：奪奧斯蒂亞港、逼羅馬以五千磅黃金等財物贖城，又扶立元老普里斯庫斯·阿塔魯斯另立皇帝。410年8月24日他自薩拉里安門入城，掠奪三日；411年再圍，用金錢與人質了事；412年被斯悌里古在北義大利擊敗，退入阿普利亞；415年入高盧，定居波爾多並為羅曼居民立法；420年病逝。亞拉里克死後，他的兄弟阿陶爾夫接位，416年娶普拉西迪亞的妹妹阿托利法。皇帝霍諾留斯自410年起坐鎮拉文納，年約三十，實際上由朝廷與元老院之間的角力左右；將軍弗拉維烏斯·斯悌里古是霍諾留斯的岳父兼攝政，408年5月被皇帝猜忌、下令處死，其子歐赫里烏斯同時遇害，這件事直接製造了西哥特反叛的土壤。禁軍總監奧利奧多魯斯主張議和，赫拉克里烏斯扣住運往羅馬的穀船不交，兩人的對立決定了410年談判的方向；教宗英諾森一世出面斡旋，以人質贖回全城。記錄者方面：左西莫斯《新史》提供最詳細的戰事經過，約爾丹的《哥特史》年代更晚且多有神話，耶柔米、奧古斯丁、奧羅修斯與底比斯的奧利奧多魯斯則從宗教與文獻角度留下另一套敘事。
peopleEn: The figures who matter revolve around Alaric and two emperors. Alaric I was king of the Visigoths, raised to the position some time between 395 and 400 AD while still young; he was beaten in 392 by Theodosius and Stilicho, fought at the Frigidus in 394 as part of the eastern army, was besieged at Pholoe in 397, and lost at Pollentia in 402 and at Verona in 403. Between 405 and 406 he entered Italy for the first time as a federate fighting alongside the Roman army against Radagaisus; after the fall of Stilicho in 408 he immediately turned his forces against Rome. He led the second of the three sieges of this campaign: he seized Portus, forced Rome to buy its freedom with five thousand pounds of gold and other treasure, and set up the senator Priscus Attalus as a rival emperor. On 24 August 410 he entered the city by the Salarian Gate and plundered it for three days; in 411 he besieged the city again and again settled the matter in gold and hostages; in 412 Stilicho beat him in the field in northern Italy and drove him into Apulia; in 415 he crossed the Alps into Gaul, settled at Bordeaux, and issued laws for his Roman subjects; he died in 420. After Alaric, his brother Athaulf succeeded him and in 416 married Atroflava, sister of Galla Placidia. Emperor Honorius sat at Ravenna from 410 onward, around thirty years old, effectively governed by the tug of war between court and senate. The general Flavius Stilicho was his father-in-law and the effective regent, and in May 408 he was killed on the emperor's suspicion, his son Eucherius dying with him; that killing created the soil in which the Visigothic revolt grew. The praetorian prefect Olympiodorus argued for negotiation while Heraclius held back the grain fleet bound for Rome, and the deadlock between the two shaped the direction of the talks in 410; Pope Innocent I took the lead in mediation, buying the city back with hostages. Of the writers, the New History of Zosimus gives the most detailed narrative of the operations, the Getica of Jordanes is later and largely legendary, while Jerome, Augustine, Paulus Orosius and Olympiodorus of Thebes preserve a different, religious and literary reading of the same events.
kits: 卡面是亞述長矛：短柄、長刃、配鐵鏨，柄尾繫鏈以便拉回。亞述浮雕裡的矛兵一律是這種樣子，它是兩河流域城邦陷落時最常見的近身兵器，也是「短柄長刃、以刺為主」這條技術路線最早的成熟形態。時間跳到410年，這條線在歐洲換成兩個名字：羅馬人叫它重標槍（pilum）與大矛（hasta），前者是兩公尺上下、鉛銎的投射槍，後者是步兵合手的刺槍；哥特人叫它 framea，槍身更長、刃更寬，形制上更接近亞述那種長刃長矛。卡面那條「鐵鏈」也不是孤例：羅馬與後來的拜占庭兵書都記有繫鏈、配鉛墜的投槍 falarica，扔出後靠鏈索拖回，與亞述矛在同一個邏輯裡。實際打到羅馬街巷的裝備如下。羅馬城防軍：弧面大盾（scutum）、短劍與長劍（gladius／spatha），以及在晚期已退位給鱗甲（lorica squamata）與鎖子甲（lorica plumata）的環甲（segmentata）；頭上是拉提凱式的脊飾盔與普通頭盔；城牆上固定有弩炮（ballista）與可移動的車弩（carroballista），配石彈與標槍。哥特步兵：長劍（spatha）與單刃短刀（seax）、橢圓木盾蒙皮並加鐵盾心、複合弓與箭，靠矛兵與盾兵混編的步兵分隊作戰，騎兵是集團衝鋒與追擊的主力。攻城與街戰用物：木梯、斧、攻城撞槌、火把與縱火用的油料；連接用的繩索、鉤爪與鐵鏈；以及最關鍵的物資——糧食船隊與河船，奧斯蒂亞港失守等於羅馬的戰爭機器缺了燃料。收穫則是車隊：亞拉里克的馬車隊既是劫掠的載具，也是營壘的骨架。簡言之，亞述長矛在此役的位置是譜系上的祖先：它提醒人，410年城牆上互刺的仍是那種短柄長刃的矛，只是名字從亞述的換成了 pilum、hasta 與 framea。
kitsEn: The card shows an Assyrian spear: a short shaft, a long blade, an iron head, and a chain at the butt so the weapon could be pulled back. The spearmen in Assyrian reliefs are invariably of this pattern; it was the commonest close-combat weapon of the two riverlands when their cities were falling one after another, and the earliest mature form of the technical line of short shaft, long blade and thrust first. By 410 that same line had acquired two names in Europe: the Romans called it the heavy javelin, the pilum, and the hasta, the first a throwing weapon about two metres long with a lead-shod point, the second a thrusting spear sized for an infantryman to handle; the Goths called it the framea, a longer weapon with a broader blade, closer in shape to the Assyrian long-bladed spear. The chain on the card is not an isolated detail either: both Roman and later Byzantine military texts record a throwing spear with a chain and a lead weight, the falarica, thrown and then dragged back by the line; it is the same logic as the Assyrian spear. The equipment actually carried through the streets of Rome was as follows. The Roman defenders: the curved oval scutum, the gladius and the spatha, and the segmentata half way out of service in favour of scale armour, lorica squamata, and mail, lorica plumata; on their heads ridge helmets of the Intercisa type and plain helmets; on the walls fixed ballistae and mobile carroballistae, with stone shot and javelins. The Gothic infantry: the spatha and the single-edged seax, oval wooden shields faced in hide and fitted with an iron boss, the composite bow and its arrows, fighting in war-bands that mixed spearmen and shield-men, with cavalry that charged in mass and pursued. For assault and street fighting: ladders, axes, rams, torches and oil for burning; ropes, hooks and chains for grappling; and above all the material that decided everything, the grain fleet and the river barges, since the loss of Portus was the loss of the fuel of the Roman war machine. The spoils were the wagon trains: Alaric's wagons were both the vehicles that carried the loot and the frame of his camp. In short, the Assyrian spear's place in this campaign is that of an ancestor in a genealogy: it reminds us that the weapons thrust at each other in the city in 410 were still the short-shafted, long-bladed spear, only the names had changed from the Assyrian to the pilum, the hasta and the framea.
tactics: 這場圍城有過三輪：第一輪是405至408年亞拉里克初入義大利的掃蕩，第二輪是409年在奧斯蒂亞港與台伯河下游的合圍，第三輪是411年的再圍。哥特人一貫的戰法是「圍而不急攻」：先以騎兵與輕步兵切斷羅馬的穀物通道，封住台伯河下游的河船，等城內饑荒成形，再談破城。409年奪取奧斯蒂亞港是這一點的關鍵；糧船進不了港，羅馬的守軍與市民先垮。410年8月24日破城，用的是夜襲加內應：史家說薩拉里安門被守軍從內打開，也有人說是守軍因飢餓與缺人而散亂；哥特人由該門突入，在城內縱火、以火炬照明夜戰，市區民兵與城防部隊被逐段擊破。掠奪持續三日，隊伍大致守紀律：彼得與保羅的兩座大教堂與拉特蘭宮被保全，但宮內康士坦丁所賜、重二千零二十五磅的銀聖體匣被取走；元老院議事舊址、埃米利亞 basilica 與薩魯斯特花園則被燒，薩魯斯特花園此後再未重建；奧古斯都與哈德良陵寢中的骨灰被拋散。撤離時亞拉里克沒有急行軍，而是帶著車隊與被擄者沿拉丁大道南走，速度被輜重拖住，斯悌里古的追兵就在後面。411年再圍羅馬，雙方再度以金錢與人質交易收場；412年斯悌里古在北義大利野戰中擊敗亞拉里克，迫使他退入阿普利亞，是羅馬在義大利最後一次大型野戰勝利。守城方的部署則是把弩炮固定在奧勒良城牆的塔樓上，以石彈與標槍覆蓋城牆外側的接近地面；缺糧、缺船、缺援兵，卻有城牆、有投石、有糧倉，這就是為什麼西哥特人最後選擇破城，而不是長期圍困。
tacticsEn: The siege went through three rounds: the first was Alaric's sweep through Italy between 405 and 408, the second the encirclement around Portus and the lower Tiber in 409, the third the renewed siege of 411. The Gothic method was consistently to besiege rather than to assault at once: cavalry and light infantry cut the grain route and sealed the river traffic on the lower Tiber, letting famine form inside the city before any storming was attempted. The capture of Portus in 409 was the pivot of this; with the grain ships unable to enter, the garrison and the citizens broke before the walls did. Rome fell on 24 August 410 by a night attack combined with treachery: the sources say the Salarian Gate was opened from within by the defenders, and others say the garrison had been thinned by hunger and desertion; the Goths came in by that gate, set fires in the city and fought the night by torchlight, and the urban militia and the city troops were broken up section by section. The plunder lasted three days and the ranks kept a rough discipline: the two great basilicas of Peter and Paul and the Lateran Palace were left standing, though the silver ciborium of Constantine, weighing two thousand and twenty-five pounds, was taken from the Lateran; the old senate house, the Basilica Aemilia and the Gardens of Sallust were burned, and the Gardens of Sallust were never rebuilt. The ashes in the mausoleums of Augustus and Hadrian were scattered. On the way out Alaric did not hurry: he moved south along the Via Latina with his wagons and his captives, his pace held back by the baggage, with Stilicho's pursuit close behind. The siege of 411 was again settled in money and hostages. In 412 Stilicho beat Alaric in the field in northern Italy and drove him into Apulia, the last great Roman field victory on Italian soil. The defence had its own doctrine: ballistae fixed on the towers of the Aurelian wall, covering with stone shot and javelins the ground from which the enemy would have to approach. Short of grain, of ships and of reinforcements, but with walls, with artillery and with granaries, the city was strong enough to make the Goths choose the storm over a long blockade.
data: 可引用的數字大致有這幾組。時間：410年8月24日破城，掠奪三日，約三日時後主力往南撤。亞拉里克的兵力：現代史家（希瑟）估計可作戰人員約四萬，另有數量不明的家眷、奴隸與隨軍匠人；左西莫斯記的「三萬」是投奔亞拉里克的德意志同盟者人數，現代學者多認為此數偏高，寧可把它理解為亞拉里克麾下總戰鬥人員的量級。錢：409年解除圍城的條件是五千磅黃金、三萬磅白銀、四千件絲袍、三千張猩紅染皮與三千磅胡椒；拉特蘭的銀聖體匣重二千零二十五磅。匈人：守城時三百匈騎據記載擊殺一千一百名哥特人，自身損失十七人；亞拉里克一度提出要一萬匈人，終未成行。東哥特：406年拉達蓋蘇斯敗亡後，其部眾中上萬人被強行編入羅馬軍隊，奴隸價格一度崩跌。羅馬方：斯悌里古在409年集結的解圍軍，左西莫斯記作數萬之眾，一般視為三萬左右，但此數只見於一人之筆。地理：羅馬到拉文納約三百公里，亞拉里克自北義大利南下再沿拉丁大道推進，全線數百公里；奧勒良城牆環城約十九公里，是守方倚重的堡壘。時間跨度：從405年越過阿爾卑斯到411年第三次圍城，前後六年；西羅馬帝國本身還再存續了六十六年，到476年才告終。
dataEn: The usable figures fall into several groups. Time: the city was entered on 24 August 410, plundered for three days, and the main body moved south roughly three days later. Alaric's strength: modern historians, Heather among them, put the number of men fit for service at around forty thousand, plus an unknown number of families, slaves and craftsmen; the thirty thousand Zosimus gives is the number of German foederati who fled to Alaric, a figure most modern scholars regard as too high, preferring to read it as the order of magnitude of the fighting force under Alaric's command. Money: the terms that bought off the siege of 409 were five thousand pounds of gold, thirty thousand pounds of silver, four thousand silk tunics, three thousand scarlet-dyed hides and three thousand pounds of pepper; the silver ciborium in the Lateran weighed two thousand and twenty-five pounds. Huns: three hundred Hunnic horsemen are said to have killed eleven hundred Goths in the defence of the city at a loss of seventeen men of their own; Alaric at one point called for ten thousand Huns, which never materialised. Ostrogoths: after Radagaisus fell in 406, more than ten thousand of his men were pressed into Roman service, and the price of slaves briefly collapsed. On the Roman side: the relief army Stilicho raised in 409, which Zosimus puts at some tens of thousands and which is generally read as around thirty thousand, though the figure rests on a single pen. Geography: roughly three hundred kilometres from Rome to Ravenna, and several hundred kilometres of advance by Alaric from northern Italy down the Via Latina; the Aurelian wall ran about nineteen kilometres around the city and was the fortress the defence relied on. Span: six years from the crossing of the Alps in 405 to the third siege of 411; the Western Roman Empire itself survived another sixty-six years, to 476.
cause: 打起來的原因分三層。最內層是羅馬自己的失策：409年亞拉里克圍城，羅馬用錢贖了兩次，也答應過人質與歸還掠奪物；但408年斯悌里古被殺後，羅馬城內開始屠殺同盟者的家庭，德意志裔的士兵與家眷大批死亡。這批人逃出城投奔亞拉里克，把一支本來安置在邊境的人集團，變成帶著全族怨恨與人口的重裝軍。亞拉里克自己的說法是羅馬先破約，所以他不接受既有的協議，這在410年再度圍城時被拿來當理由。第二層是西部的結構性弱點：406年拉達蓋蘇斯以左西莫斯所記「數十萬」的隊伍（後世多認為被誇大）掃過北義大利，羅馬的野戰軍被消耗，雖然拉達蓋蘇斯敗亡，但田莊、糧食與人口都已毀於戰火；到409年，義大利能拉出來的援兵只有斯悌里古臨時拼湊的解圍軍。第三層是權力結構：皇帝在拉文納，元老院在羅馬，兩邊對戰與否的判斷不同；亞拉里克甚至在409年扶立元老普里斯庫斯·阿塔魯斯為帝，用的正是這個分歧。410年他提出的條件其實極為克制——在諾里庫姆給他土地，由皇帝按需要供應穀物；史家底比斯的奧利奧多魯斯認為這已經很公道，但霍諾留斯的朝廷一口回絕，因為朝廷受的是有約束的誓言與開戰的既定政策。於是談判破裂，圍城升級為攻城，最終鬧到破城與三日劫掠。
causeEn: There were three layers of cause. The innermost was Rome's own misjudgement. In 409 Alaric besieged the city and Rome bought off the siege twice with money, promising hostages and the return of plunder; but after Stilicho was killed in 408 the Romans began killing the families of the foederati inside the city, and German soldiers and their dependants were massacred in large numbers. Those who escaped fled to Alaric, and turned a federate settlement originally placed on the frontier into a war-band that carried a whole people's grievances and population with it. Alaric's own account was that Rome had broken faith first, so he would not be bound by the existing agreement, and that was the justification he produced when he returned to besiege the city in 410. The second layer was the structural weakness of the west: in 406 Radagaisus led a host that Zosimus puts at several hundred thousand, a number later generations rightly treat as exaggerated, across northern Italy; the Roman field army was used up, and although Radagaisus was beaten the farms, the grain and the population of the north were already ruined. By 409 the only relief Italy could raise was the army Stilicho hastily assembled. The third layer was the structure of power: the emperor sat at Ravenna, the senate at Rome, and the two judged the question of war differently; in 409 Alaric even set up the senator Priscus Attalus as emperor, precisely because that division existed. The terms Alaric proposed in 410 were in fact extremely modest, land in Noricum and such grain as the emperor thought necessary; the historian Olympiodorus of Thebes thought them very reasonable, but the court of Honorius refused them outright, bound as it was by oaths and by a settled policy of war. So the talks broke down, the siege was escalated into an assault, and the result was the sack and three days of plunder.
impact: 410年之後，羅馬在拉丁西方世界的象徵地位第一次被打穿。此前八百年，羅馬城被視為不可能被外敵攻破的地方，而「凡是羅馬人者皆在羅馬的城牆之內」這種安全感，是帝國合法性敘事的底層。劫掠的消息傳開之後，伯利恆的耶柔米寫信說世界的全部都被熄滅了；希波的主教奧古斯丁在《上帝之城》裡用整整一本書回應，把城陷解釋為上帝對驕傲與信仰混亂的懲罰；奧羅修斯則把它寫成神罰。這場劫掠也把帝國政治推向另一個方向：此後羅馬朝廷學會以條約、贖金與「土地交換」處理蠻族王，而不是每每開戰；把北蠻首領直接拉進帝國外交，同一時期的元老普里斯庫斯·阿塔魯斯被扶上紫袍，說明西部的分裂隨時可以被外部利用。軍事的教訓更直接：城牆再強，擋不住的是糧船與港口，奧斯蒂亞港的失守比城牆上的任何缺口都致命；帝國在西部的野戰能力被拉達蓋蘇斯與亞拉里克兩役消耗殆盡，而守城的兵是傭兵、同盟者與外族騎兵——受薪的帝國軍與被雇的羅馬人混編。最後，城市本身並未毀滅：行政機構、元老院與教會都在劫掠後繼續運作，這使得410年被後世視為西羅馬崩解的里程碑，卻又不是終點；西羅馬還撐了六十六年。真正崩掉的是「羅馬永不會陷落」這個信念。為回應劫掠而寫成的《上帝之城》把城市從地上的羅馬改寫成天上的城，這是羅馬概念的一次永久轉向。
impactEn: After 410 the symbolic status of Rome in the Latin western world was broken through for the first time. For eight hundred years the city had been regarded as a place no foreign enemy could take, and the sense that anyone who was a Roman was safe inside Roman walls was the bedrock of the empire's legitimacy narrative. Once the news spread, Jerome of Bethlehem wrote that the whole world had been extinguished; Augustine of Hippo answered with an entire book, the City of God, reading the fall of the city as God's punishment for pride and confused religion; and Paulus Orosius wrote it as divine judgement. The sack also pushed imperial politics in another direction: from then on the Roman court learned to deal with barbarian kings through treaties, ransoms and exchanges of land rather than by fighting each time, and the direct admission of northern chieftains into imperial diplomacy was a practice born here; the elevation of the senator Priscus Attalus to the purple shows how readily the division of the west could be exploited from outside. The military lesson is even more direct: however strong the walls, what they could not hold off was the grain fleet and the harbour, and the loss of Portus was more fatal than any breach in the masonry. The empire's capacity to fight in the west had been spent by Radagaisus and by Alaric, and the troops who held the city were mercenaries, foederati and foreign cavalry, a Roman army of pay conscripted and hired side by side. Finally, the city itself was not destroyed: the administrative machinery, the senate and the church all kept working after the plunder, which is why 410 is treated by later generations as a landmark in the collapse of the Western Empire and yet not as its end; the empire held on for another sixty-six years. What really broke was the belief that Rome would never fall. The City of God, written in answer to the sack, moved the city from Rome on earth to Rome in heaven, and that shift in the meaning of Rome was permanent.
result: 結局分三層看。城池：410年8月24日破城，掠奪三日後主力南撤，羅馬城本身沒有被焚毀——大教堂與多數民宅保存，元老院與港口的功能逐步恢復，但城市的財富、人口與行政元氣大傷，朝廷此後也沒有回遷。戰局：411年亞拉里克再度圍城，最後仍以金錢與人質收場；412年斯悌里古在北義大利擊敗他，迫使亞拉里克退入阿普利亞，這是羅馬在義大利最後一次成功的野戰；此後亞拉里克放棄義大利，415年渡阿爾卑斯入高盧，在波爾多設宮廷，頒布給羅曼居民的法律，並在418年與羅馬訂約取得合法地位，420年病逝於巴里。帝國：西部沒有因410年而滅亡，476年才終結；但從此羅馬只能靠與蠻族王條約、贖金與外交周旋，帝國的主動權在西部已不在自己手上。戰役的最終意義寫在兩件東西上：亞拉里克的馬車隊把羅馬的財富運出了城，而羅馬的城牆與弩炮證明了一件事——守住城市的不是牆，是糧食與盟軍；410年羅馬輸掉的正是後者。
resultEn: The outcome can be read on three levels. The city: entered on 24 August 410, plundered for three days, the main body then moved south; the city was not burned to the ground, the basilicas and most of the houses survived and the senate and the harbour slowly resumed their functions, but the wealth, the population and the administrative energy of Rome were badly hurt, and the court never came back. The campaign: Alaric besieged the city again in 411 and settled once more in gold and hostages; in 412 Stilicho defeated him in the field in northern Italy and drove him into Apulia, the last successful Roman field battle on Italian soil; Alaric then left Italy, crossed the Alps into Gaul in 415, established his court at Bordeaux, issued laws for his Roman subjects, secured legal standing by treaty with Rome in 418, and died of illness at Bari in 420. The empire: the west did not end in 410 but in 476, though from then on Rome could only manage the barbarian kings by treaty, ransom and diplomacy, and the initiative in the west was no longer its own. The final meaning of the campaign is written on two objects: Alaric's wagons carried Rome's wealth out of the city, while Rome's walls and ballistae proved that what holds a city is not the wall but the grain and the allies, and in 410 it was the latter that Rome lost.
